Wie präzise du triffst, entscheidet die Wertung — exakt wie in osu!mania:

[b]MAX[/b]  — bis ±16,5 ms daneben (perfekt!)
[b]300[/b]  — sehr gut
[b]200[/b]  — gut
[b]100[/b]  — ok
[b]50[/b]   — gerade noch
[b]✕ MISS[/b] — daneben oder gar nicht gedrückt

Die Fenster hängen von der [b]OD[/b] der Map ab (höher = strenger). Viel zu früh drücken frisst die Note übrigens auch — also nicht panisch hammern!

en:
How precisely you hit decides the judgement — exactly like osu!mania:

[b]MAX[/b]  — up to ±16.5 ms off (perfect!)
[b]300[/b]  — great
[b]200[/b]  — good
[b]100[/b]  — ok
[b]50[/b]   — barely
[b]✕ MISS[/b] — off or not pressed at all

The windows depend on the map's [b]OD[/b] (higher = stricter). Pressing way too early also eats the note — so don't mash in panic!

The small [b]UR bar[/b] in the middle of the screen shows each hit as a tick: left of the center = early, right = late. The yellow arrow is your trend.

keys:
Deine Accuracy (Acc) berechnet sich genau nach der osu!mania-Formel:

[b]Acc = (300·(MAX+300) + 200·n200 + 100·n100 + 50·n50) / (300 · alle Noten)[/b]

Heißt: MAX und 300 zählen voll, ein 200er nur zwei Drittel, ein 100er ein Drittel, ein 50er ein Sechstel, ein Miss null.

[b]Beispiel:[/b] 2 Noten — 1x MAX + 1x 200er:
(300 + 200) / 600 = [b]83,33 %[/b]

[b]Grades:[/b]
SS = 100 %   ·   S über 95 %   ·   A über 90 %
B über 80 %   ·   C über 70 %   ·   sonst D

en:
Your accuracy (acc) uses exactly the osu!mania formula:

[b]Acc = (300·(MAX+300) + 200·n200 + 100·n100 + 50·n50) / (300 · all notes)[/b]

So: MAX and 300 count fully, a 200 only two thirds, a 100 one third, a 50 one sixth, a miss nothing.

[b]Example:[/b] 2 notes — 1x MAX + 1x 200:
(300 + 200) / 600 = [b]83.33%[/b]

[b]Grades:[/b]
SS = 100%   ·   S above 95%   ·   A above 90%
B above 80%   ·   C above 70%   ·   else D

en:
pp measure how strong a single play was — based on [b]star rating[/b] and [b]accuracy[/b].

They are calculated with rosu-pp (official mania formula). Good to know: [b]you only get lots of pp from ~80% accuracy[/b] — above that the curve rises steeply. Below it, a TETHRA minimum makes sure every play still counts a little.

[b]Your profile pp[/b] (main menu, profile card): your best scores are sorted and added up weighted — the best counts fully, the second 95%, the third 90.25% and so on (like osu). Only your [b]best score per diff[/b] counts.

In short: better play one map cleanly at 95%+ than ten maps at 70%.

en:
[b]Scroll speed (x0.5–x3.0):[/b] How fast the notes approach. Purely visual — the timing windows stay exactly the same, so it is never unfair. Higher = fewer notes on screen at once (clearer on fast maps).

[b]Audio offset (±200 ms):[/b] Makes up for the latency of your audio setup. After a play, check the [b]Ø value[/b] on the results screen: if it says e.g. "Ø +20 ms (late)", move the offset towards -20.

[b]Hitsounds + volume:[/b] Click feedback on hits, with its own volume.

[b]Effect intensity:[/b] Off / Subtle / Full — dims waves, glow effects, camera movement and so on.

[b]FPS limit:[/b] [b]Unlimited[/b] = most precise input (recommended). VSync = no tearing, but more latency.

[b]Fullscreen:[/b] {F11} at any time.

[b]1) Online browser:[/b] In song select, click [b]"⤓ Online"[/b] at the top. You see suggestions right away — only [b]ranked 4K mania[/b] maps. Click a card = [b]listen[/b], "⤓ Download" puts it straight into your library. Star filters included.

[b]2) Your own files:[/b] Put any osu!mania [b].osz[/b] file into the [b]maps[/b] folder (next to TETHRA.exe) — or drag & drop it onto the game window.

[b]3) Collections:[/b] In the info panel, click [b]"+ Collection"[/b] — put maps into your own lists (e.g. "Training", "Favorites") and filter by them in the browser's Collections tab.

Note: only [b]4K[/b] diffs (4 columns) are playable — others are hidden automatically.

keys:
[b]Raum erstellen:[/b] Hauptmenü › Multiplayer › "+ Raum erstellen". Der Port öffnet sich automatisch (UPnP) und du bekommst einen kurzen [b]Raum-Code[/b] — den schickst du deinen Freunden.

[b]Beitreten:[/b] Code eintippen › Beitreten. Im selben WLAN erscheinen Räume sogar automatisch in der Liste.

[b]Die Krone 👑:[/b] Wer sie trägt, wählt die Map (der Host kann sie per Klick weitergeben). Fehlt dir die gewählte Map, lädt sie [b]automatisch[/b] herunter.

[b]Im Spiel:[/b] Links läuft das [b]Live-Scoreboard[/b] — du siehst sofort, wenn du jemanden überholst. Das Intro wird nur übersprungen, wenn [b]alle[/b] die {Leertaste} drücken. Am Ende zeigt die Rangliste alle Ergebnisse.

Beim ersten Start fragt die Windows-Firewall — [b]"Zulassen"[/b] klicken!

en:
[b]Create a room:[/b] Main menu › Multiplayer › "+ Create room". The port opens automatically (UPnP) and you get a short [b]room code[/b] — send it to your friends.

[b]Join:[/b] Type in the code › Join. On the same Wi-Fi, rooms even show up in the list automatically.

[b]The crown 👑:[/b] Whoever wears it picks the map (the host can pass it on with a click). If you don't have the picked map, it [b]downloads automatically[/b].

[b]In game:[/b] The [b]live scoreboard[/b] runs on the left — you see right away when you overtake someone. The intro is only skipped when [b]everyone[/b] presses {Space}. At the end the ranking shows all results.

On first start the Windows firewall asks — click [b]"Allow"[/b]!

en:
Next up is the [b]practice map[/b] ("tatatat - e", 4K Beginner — nice and slow).

It [b]pauses automatically[/b] before anything new happens and explains it to you:
• your first [b]note[/b]
• your first [b]hold note[/b] (hold it!)
• your first [b]chord[/b] (two keys at once)
• your [b]HUD[/b]

After each explanation it goes on with a short 3-2-1. [b]No Fail is on[/b] — you can't do anything wrong. The map doesn't count towards your stats.

Tip: you can restart the tutorial any time with {R} or leave it with {Esc} › Song select.
